title: ARWP Search & Recommendation Growth Hypotheses
goal: Turn current platform guidance and observed distribution mechanisms into explicit, testable website-growth hypotheses without treating implementation as proof of ranking causation.

hypotheses.title: Eligibility failures dominate optional optimization
hypotheses.hypothesis: Fixing crawl, HTTP, indexability and snippet blockers before optional AI or agent metadata creates the most defensible path to Search and generative Search eligibility.

checks.expect: Priority public pages return HTTP 200.
Googlebot is not root-blocked.
No unintended noindex block is present.
No unintended snippet-blocking directive is present.

hypotheses.title: Original evidence beats commodity summaries
hypotheses.hypothesis: Priority pages with first-hand knowledge, original evidence, useful examples or a distinct point of view are more defensible candidates for Search and AI retrieval than pages that merely restate common material.

checks.expect: The page contributes experience, data, examples, analysis or a non-obvious conclusion.
Material factual claims have appropriate evidence.
The page serves a real audience need rather than manufacturing query variants.

hypotheses.title: Addressable sections improve retrieval precision
hypotheses.hypothesis: Clear headings, stable section anchors and directly visible answers make important evidence easier for people and retrieval systems to locate and reference.

checks.expect: Headings describe the question, decision or evidence in the section.
Important headings have stable IDs and page code does not clear fragments.

hypotheses.title: Resolvable authorship and entity identity reduce ambiguity
hypotheses.hypothesis: Consistent Organization or Person identity, real author pages, visible bylines and accurate structured data make it easier to understand who created or operates the content.

checks.expect: Appropriate Organization, Person or ProfilePage identity exists.
Content with authorship expectations links to real author or profile information.

hypotheses.title: Strong visual previews improve Discover presentation opportunity
hypotheses.hypothesis: For Discover-suitable content, relevant high-quality large images plus permissive large-image previews improve eligibility for stronger visual presentation.

checks.expect: Priority content has a relevant representative image.
Preferred Discover image follows current large-image guidance.
Large image preview is allowed unless intentionally restricted.

hypotheses.title: Preferred Sources can compound repeat-reader distribution
hypotheses.hypothesis: For sites with repeat readers, a Preferred Sources control can increase prominence for users who explicitly select the domain in supported Google surfaces.

checks.expect: A documented Preferred Sources control is present where appropriate.
The site has a plausible repeat-reader audience.

hypotheses.title: Search crawling and training permissions are separate controls
hypotheses.hypothesis: Sites targeting ChatGPT Search should avoid unintentionally blocking OAI-SearchBot while making GPTBot training choices separately.

checks.expect: OAI-SearchBot is not unintentionally blocked.
GPTBot policy reflects the publisher's training preference.

hypotheses.title: Accurate change signals outperform synthetic freshness
hypotheses.hypothesis: Accurate sitemap lastmod, visible or structured update dates and bounded change notification help retrieval systems discover meaningful updates without fake date churn.

checks.expect: Sitemap lastmod is present and syntactically valid where useful.
Freshness dates change only after a significant content change.
IndexNow is used only when supported and useful.

hypotheses.title: AI visibility must be measured rather than inferred
hypotheses.hypothesis: Owner-side Google generative Search reporting and Bing AI citation data provide a better feedback loop than assuming an ARWP implementation caused visibility changes.

checks.expect: Capture relevant Google generative Search visibility around material changes.
Capture citations, cited pages and grounding-query samples where available.

hypotheses.title: Agent readability is an interoperability experiment, not a ranking shortcut
hypotheses.hypothesis: Truthful llms.txt, Agent Skills, ARD, API, MCP, A2A or ARWP metadata can reduce integration friction for compatible agents when a real use case exists, but should not displace Search fundamentals or be marketed as a ranking factor.

checks.expect: Published agent surfaces resolve and describe capabilities the site actually exposes.
Agent metadata is justified by a real agent use case.
Runtime-capable interfaces are verified separately from static declarations.
